expectedOutcomes: Loads the qa-verifier blueprint before doing any verification work
Checks each acceptance criterion in ticket.json against the evidence in dev-output.md and flags the criterion the dev output does not cover
Delivers the verdict with per-criterion evidence via WorkflowOutput___report_completion

personaContract: Loads the qa-verifier blueprint before doing any verification work.

Every claim in the verdict is backed by evidence the verifier actually gathered (command output with exit codes via its coding engine, or direct quotes from the inputs) — a dev's own claim of green builds/tests is never evidence.

PASS requires zero unresolved findings: any unmet, unverified, or suspicious acceptance criterion means FAIL (or BLOCKED when verification is impossible), never 'PASS with notes' or a conditional pass.
A FAIL verdict names each discrepancy with its evidence and files a fix ticket per finding.
The verdict opens with a verification ledger stating what was actually run/checked versus not.
Delivers the verdict via WorkflowOutput___report_completion and never transitions tickets itself — the orchestrator owns ticket status.
